name: MoReBench
description: MoReBench is a large-scale moral reasoning benchmark that evaluates LLMs on ethical decision-making through procedural and pluralistic reasoning. It contains over 1,000 moral reasoning scenarios with more than 23,000 rubric criteria, developed with input from over 50 PhD-level experts, assessing reasoning across five major normative ethics frameworks in both advisory and autonomous decision-making contexts.
reputation: Novel benchmark highlighting that scaling laws on math/code do not predict moral reasoning ability
notes: Includes MoReBench-Easy (baseline) and MoReBench-Hard (length-normalized) variants; MoReBench-Theory subset tests 150 examples under normative ethical frameworks; CC BY 4.0 license.
